_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 18-25 October 2025: the grid, Japan quakes, Branson, and North Korea.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether what he was saying is coming, says he hears a stirring inside about it, and suggests they may come to an agreement with the government now and should pray for that.
mentions.quote: Maybe they will come to an agreement with the government right now
mentions.falsify_match: A deal ending the government shutdown.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Posed as a maybe, and the shutdown ended on 12 November 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says beautiful music is coming and would expect it now, and that praying the night before they saw the power grid again as the president begins doing certain things.
mentions.quote: as we were praying last night, we saw the power grid again
mentions.falsify_match: A major grid failure in the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The grid recurs across the corpus without a date.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for whoever runs the cyber division to have supernatural wisdom against attacks he believes have already started, and says he saw Trojan horses coming in and causing disruption.
mentions.quote: I saw Trojan horses coming in and causing disruption
mentions.falsify_match: A significant Trojan-based intrusion into American infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None disclosed. Saying they have already started removes the forward element.

mentions.claim_text: He refers to sanctions on Russia and its oil companies and says that when you corner people something follows, though he leaves what unspecified.
mentions.quote: you try to put people in a corner
mentions.falsify_match: Russian retaliation for the October 2025 oil sanctions.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He does not say what follows.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking prophetically he says pressure is coming on the church and a new Holy Ghost oil will flow out of that pressure, naming Canada, America, England, China and Europe.
mentions.quote: THE PRESSURE IS COMING ON MY CHURCH AND the oil will flow
mentions.falsify_match: Pressure on churches in those countries followed by a revival out of it.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Pressure and oil both lack thresholds.

mentions.claim_text: He says America will not change until the pulpits change, that people do not want to hear it, and that a great shaking is coming that will not be skinny jeans and fog machines.
mentions.quote: AMERICA WILL NOT CHANGE UNTIL the pulpits change
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a conditional about church culture with no measure on either side.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is all about the fig tree, and distinguishes standing with Israel from agreeing with everything Israel does.
mentions.quote: I always stand with Israel, but I do not always have to agree
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of his own position.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to be a contender under the pressure of the end times and to expand believing so they reach the lost.
mentions.quote: It is time to expand your believing
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: exhortation.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a crackdown in China with Christians imprisoned and the church persecuted at a great scale, saying it is all on the news.
mentions.quote: They are persecuting the church in China right now
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: he cites current reporting as his source.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the subject changes to power and the grid, notes the switch, and names the state of Texas.
mentions.quote: He is talking about power, the grid. In the state of Texas
mentions.falsify_match: A Texas grid failure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Texas is the one named location in the grid material, which makes it the checkable version.

mentions.claim_text: He describes earthquakes as a pulse, upticks and downticks like a heartbeat, and says the faster it gets the closer the labour pains.
mentions.quote: concerning earthquakes uptick down uptick down. It is a pulse
mentions.falsify_match: An accelerating rate of significant earthquakes, measurable against USGS records.
mentions.falsify_miss: No acceleration. Global rates of magnitude 7 and above have been broadly flat for decades.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees great destruction on Japan from earthquakes soon to begin, describing it like the winding of a top and the waves of the earth.
mentions.quote: I see great destruction on Japan on this earthquakes soon to begin
mentions.falsify_match: A destructive earthquake sequence in Japan.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Soon carries no date, and Japan records about 1,500 felt quakes a year.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will come in Australia and Los Angeles and through Tennessee, in a greater worship than has been seen before.
mentions.quote: it will come on in Australia and in Los Angeles
mentions.falsify_match: A worship movement emerging in those three places.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Three named places, which is more than most of the revival material offers.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that Oklahoma would be divided and split blue and red, correcting the line to run from Miami to Lawton, and says they cannot lose Oklahoma to the Democratic Party.
mentions.quote: it would be split from Miami to Lawton
mentions.falsify_match: Oklahoma splitting politically along that line.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Note the endpoint has changed from Altus in the June 2025 telling to Lawton here, both in the southwest.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is sending his people ahead of time to get ready, and that he has learned through a young man of prophecy after prophecy on the same subject.
mentions.quote: God is sending his people ahead of time getting them ready
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: corroboration from other people material.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he did not feel the current arrangement would last long, and that he has seen a great escalation of war coming out of Syria with attacks from Iran and Turkey.
mentions.quote: a great escalation of war coming from Syria and attacking from Iran and Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: War escalating out of Syria with Iranian and Turkish involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Three named states and a direction.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts that 47 million dollars had to be given to a university that would otherwise have closed its doors over mismanagement of money, and says God used them to save it.
mentions.quote: had to give them $47 million. Or they would have closed their doors
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a recounted rescue with a specific figure attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes the number on her as fifty thousand, allowing it could be another zero at five hundred thousand, seeing the number five fading on a billboard.
mentions.quote: The number that is on her for $50,000
mentions.falsify_match: A bounty at one of those figures on the woman in view.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Hedged by a factor of ten, and this is the 20 October telling, eight days before the whistleblower version.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that angels surround them, that the glory of the Lord is around them, that they are called to the kingdom for such a time as this, and over their security detail.
mentions.quote: Your angels are around and about them
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a protection petition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says New York is in trouble with a great shaking coming to it including the real estate market, and that billionaire row is fleeing.
mentions.quote: A great shaking is coming to New York. Billionaire row. They are fleeing
mentions.falsify_match: A New York real estate collapse with high net worth outflow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is the 20 October telling, nine days before the near-identical one, and both precede the mayoral election.

mentions.claim_text: He says the California governor days are numbered, that he means removal and not death, and that asked when, all he saw was him fading.
mentions.quote: Gavin days are numbered. I am talking about removal
mentions.falsify_match: The California governor leaving office early.
mentions.falsify_miss: He serves his term to January 2027. This is the earlier of the two tellings, 20 October 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Declarative prayer that Jesus is Lord over America, the southern border, MS-13, the FBI, corrupt officials and the judges.
mentions.quote: Jesus is Lord over corrupt government officials
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: declaration.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has felt the anointing lift off him and that sometimes you have to unhook, noting he can stay on the vein a long time.
mentions.quote: I have felt the anointing lift off of me
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a note about ending the stream.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jesus Christ is coming and viewers must have an urgency about the return.
mentions.quote: You must have an urgency about our Father return
mentions.falsify_match: The return occurs.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. No date.

mentions.claim_text: He describes meeting people at a prayer conference from Sweden and Mexico, and a man who happened to be there.
mentions.quote: I met some people from Sweden today, some from Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an account of the conference.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the central part of America on the New Madrid fault was picked as a major place for a shaking to awaken, and that a great revival will come to Branson, Missouri.
mentions.quote: a great revival will come to Branson, Missouri
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival centred on Branson, Missouri.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named town, which is checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says the sister days were numbered, that God would give North Korea a window for a major outpouring, and that a great harvest of souls would come there.
mentions.quote: God was going to give North Korea a window of opportunity
mentions.falsify_match: Open religious activity in North Korea, and the removal of the leader sister.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Kim Yo-jong is the presumed subject and remains in place.

mentions.claim_text: He says prayer could stop or delay some of it because it will be very bad for Poland and Romania and other nations, and refers to the enemy within and the Red Dawn.
mentions.quote: this is going to be very bad for Poland and Romania
mentions.falsify_match: War reaching Poland and Romania.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Romania is added to the Poland material here.

mentions.claim_text: He prays expecting things to change in the Ukraine war for the safety of the people, saying he knows what the word says but they will still pray.
mentions.quote: I know what your word says, but we are still going to pray
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition against an outcome he believes scripture requires.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees it again but cannot pray it in English because his spirit does not line up with it, and that this is not praying a lie.
mentions.quote: I do not feel my spirit lining up with it when I pray
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a note about his own praying, worth keeping because it is a rare admission that he cannot pray against something he has seen.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.
